_comment: Run template for ornl-supermarket-fdd: REFERENCE ONLY -- no rule. CAMBER has no refrigeration-rack detector: its superheat / subcooling / suction and head-pressure drift rules are chiller rules (load-normalised through chilled-water flow and tons, which a rack does not have, and fed by controller-reported superheat, which this dataset publishes empty), and compressor_short_cycle would flag every fault-free baseline (the fixed-speed MT compressors stage in 8-17 s bursts, the LT compressor cycles 8-11 times an hour by design). The template exists so `camber report` and the trend viewer show both circuits (LT_CIRCUIT / MT_CIRCUIT __<test>, class REFRIG_CIRCUIT) next to their fault labels.
